description: Implement Reports & Analytics feature with backend API endpoints for statistical data and frontend dashboard with Brutalist-styled charts. This feature provides overview statistics, course distribution, age distribution, and enrollment trends using existing Student model data.
steps: 1. Create models/Report.js (optional helper) or use aggregation queries directly in controller

2. Create controllers/reportController.js with 4 async handler functions: getOverview (totalStudents, totalCourses, avgAge from Student.aggregate), getCourseDistribution (group by course with counts and percentages), getAgeDistribution (bucket ages into ranges: 16-20, 21-25, 26-30, 31+), getEnrollmentTrends (group by month from createdAt field for last 6 months)

3. Create routes/reportRoutes.js with GET routes: /api/reports/overview, /api/reports/course-distribution, /api/reports/age-distribution, /api/reports/enrollment-trends. No validation middleware needed (GET requests with no params)
4. Register reportRoutes in app.js with app.use('/api/reports', reportRoutes) before the catch-all SPA route
5. Add REPORTS sidebar navigation item in public/index.html after STUDENTS, before SETTINGS. Use existing nav-link class pattern with border-2 border-border-color hover:border-accent

6. Add reports view section in public/index.html with statistics cards grid, CSS-based bar charts for course distribution (divs with width percentages and bg-accent), CSS-based horizontal bars for age distribution, and line chart representation using divs for enrollment trends. Follow existing Brutalist color scheme: #111111 bg, #FFD83D accents, #F5F2EA text

7. Extend public/app.js with loadReports() function to fetch all 4 endpoints, renderReportsView() to display statistics cards and charts, and showReportsView() navigation handler. Use existing debounce and state management patterns

8. Create tests/integration/reports.test.js following existing test pattern: require('../setup'), use createTestStudent() from tests/utils.js, test each endpoint for 200 status, correct data structure, aggregation logic (create students with known data, verify calculated values)
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/reports/overview returns {totalStudents: number, totalCourses: number, avgAge: number} with 200 status
GET /api/reports/course-distribution returns array of {course: string, count: number, percentage: number} with 200 status
GET /api/reports/age-distribution returns array of {range: string, count: number} for 4 age ranges with 200 status
GET /api/reports/enrollment-trends returns array of {month: string, count: number} for last 6 months with 200 status
REPORTS sidebar item navigates to reports view with statistics and CSS-based charts
All integration tests in tests/integration/reports.test.js pass
Running npm test shows no regressions in existing tests
verification: Run npm run test:integration -- reports.test.js to verify report endpoints with test data
Run npm test to verify full test suite passes with no regressions

Start server with npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:5000, click REPORTS in sidebar, verify statistics cards display, verify course distribution bars render, verify age distribution bars render, verify enrollment trends display
findings: Implementation completed successfully. All 9 report integration tests pass. Full test suite shows 194 tests passing with 100% coverage on report controller and routes. Frontend navigation properly toggles between Dashboard and Reports views. CSS-based charts render correctly using Brutalist design patterns with #FFD83D accent color for bars.
